headline: On last trading day, small and midcaps posted worst weekly decline in two years while Jio IPO saw massive bids.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Small and midcap indices posted their worst weekly decline in two years.
Swiggy stock dropped 16% to a record low as quick-commerce losses widened.
India's net FDI inflows fell to $3 billion in August.
Infosys expressed caution on growth due to intensifying competition despite being upbeat on deal wins.
whatHappening: Jio IPO received Rs 7.4 lakh crore in bids with 22x subscription on Friday.
IndusInd Bank reported a net profit of Rs 1,242 crore driven by lower provisions.
BSE started the hunt for a successor to its MD & CEO ahead of a 2027 exit.
Swiggy plunged 16% to hit a new record low.
summary: Markets are closed for the weekend after small and midcap indices recorded their worst weekly drop in two years. Swiggy plunged 16% on widening quick-commerce losses, while IndusInd Bank posted Rs 1,242 crore in net profit. Meanwhile, the Jio IPO closed with an overwhelming Rs 7.4 lakh crore in total bids.
